steps.name: tokenizer
steps.expr: let ok=0,bad=[]; D.tokCheck.forEach(c=>{const ids=TOK.encode(c.text); if(JSON.stringify(ids)===JSON.stringify(c.ids)) ok++; else bad.push(c.text.slice(0,30));}); let dec=0; D.tokCheck.forEach(c=>{ if(TOK.decode(c.ids)===c.decoded) dec++; }); return 'encode '+ok+'/'+D.tokCheck.length+' decode '+dec+'/'+D.tokCheck.length+' '+bad.join('|')

steps.name: lstm-greedy
steps.expr: LSTM.init(); const t0=performance.now(); const res=D.lstmCheck.greedy.map(g=>{const st=LSTM.newState(); const pids=TOK.encode(g.prompt); let lg=LSTM.feed([TOK.BOS].concat(pids),st); const out=pids.slice(); for(let k=0;k<60;k++){const n=argmax(lg); out.push(n); if(n===TOK.EOS) break; lg=LSTM.step(n,st);} const ref=g.ids.slice(0, g.ids.indexOf(TOK.EOS)>=0? g.ids.indexOf(TOK.EOS)+1:60); return JSON.stringify(out.slice(0,ref.length))===JSON.stringify(ref);}); return res.join(',')+' '+((performance.now()-t0)/5).toFixed(0)+'ms/run'

steps.name: lstm-top10
steps.expr: const st=LSTM.newState(); const lg=LSTM.feed([TOK.BOS].concat(TOK.encode(D.lstmCheck.top.prompt)),st); const p=softmax(lg); const top=topIdx(p,10); const maxd=Math.max(...D.lstmCheck.top.ids.map((id,i)=>Math.abs(p[id]-D.lstmCheck.top.probs[i]))); const temps=D.temperature.panel.map(tp=>{const pt=softmax(lg,tp.T); const ti=topIdx(pt,10).map(i=>TOK.vocab[i]); return JSON.stringify(ti.slice(0,5))===JSON.stringify(tp.tokens.slice(0,5));}); return 'ids '+(JSON.stringify(top)===JSON.stringify(D.lstmCheck.top.ids))+' maxdiff '+maxd.toExponential(1)+' temps '+temps.join(',')

steps.name: holtz
steps.expr: const r=window.__demo.holtz.compute(0); const ref=D.lstmCheck.pHuman; const maxd=Math.max(...ref.map((v,i)=>Math.abs(v-r.pHuman[i]))); const maxg=Math.max(...D.holtzman.pGreedy.map((v,i)=>Math.abs(v-r.pGreedy[i]))); window.__demo.holtz.paint(); return 'len '+r.pHuman.length+'/'+ref.length+' human maxdiff '+maxd.toExponential(1)+' greedy-vs-float '+maxg.toExponential(1)+' svg '+!!document.querySelector('#holtz-chart svg')

steps.name: sampler
steps.expr: $('#gen-prompt').value='Заходит мужик в бар'; window.__demo.start(); while(window.__demo.stepOnce()){} return TOK.decode(window.__demo.sampler.ids).slice(0,100)

steps.name: bpe-encode
steps.expr: $('#bpe-word').value='инквизиция'; $('#bpe-word').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const pieces=$$('#bpe-word-out .tok').map(t=>t.textContent); const ref=D.bpeToy.words.find(w=>w.w==='инквизиция').pieces; return JSON.stringify(pieces)+' vs '+JSON.stringify(ref)+' merges-match '+(JSON.stringify(D.bpeToy.merges.slice(0,300))===JSON.stringify(window.__demo.toyMerges()))

steps.name: labels
steps.expr: let clipped=[]; $$('svg').forEach(s=>{const vb=s.viewBox.baseVal; $$('text',s).filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')).forEach(t=>{try{const b=t.getBBox(); if(b.x<-1||b.x+b.width>vb.width+1||b.y<-1||b.y+b.height>vb.height+1) clipped.push(t.textContent+'@'+(s.parentElement.id||s.parentElement.className)+' '+[b.x|0,b.y|0,b.width|0,b.height|0]+' vb '+vb.width+'x'+vb.height);}catch(_){}});}); return clipped.length+' clipped: '+clipped.slice(0,6).join(' | ')

steps.name: overlaps
steps.expr: let ov=[]; $$('svg').forEach(s=>{const ts=$$('text',s).filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')).map(t=>{const b=t.getBBox(); return {t:t.textContent,b};}).filter(x=>x.b.width>0); for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const a=ts[i].b,b=ts[j].b; if(a.x<b.x+b.width-1&&b.x<a.x+a.width-1&&a.y<b.y+b.height-1&&b.y<a.y+a.height-1) ov.push(ts[i].t+'/'+ts[j].t+'@'+(s.parentElement.id||''));}}); return ov.length+' overlaps: '+ov.slice(0,8).join(' | ')

screens.expr: $('#gen-prompt').value='Заходит мужик в бар'; window.__demo.start(); while(window.__demo.stepOnce()){} window.__demo.paintOut(); window.__demo.paintDist();
